nodes.description: Privileged owner address stored privately; gates _mints, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate.
Public mapping of token balances mutated by transferFrom, _mints, batchSend and the constructor.
Public nested mapping of spenders' allowances, written by approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Private per-address counter of sales, incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Private whitelist mapping read by ensure and granted by _mints.
Private minimum sale amount (scaled) set by init and enforced by condition.
Private maximum sale amount (scaled) set by init and enforced by condition.
Private maximum number of sales per address set by init and enforced by condition.
Address exempted from sale gating, written by setTradeAddress and read by ensure.
Public total supply assigned in the constructor.
Constant 18 decimals used to scale mint and init amounts.
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address referenced by ensure and the constructor allowance.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
Internal view gate that whitelists owner, the computed UNI pair, tradeAddress and canSale entries before calling condition.
Public payable transferFrom that mutates allowance, balances and _onSaleNum without SafeMath, then calls ensure.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] unconditionally.
Internal view that enforces _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale constraints on the transfer.
Owner-only function that delegatecalls arbitrary attacker-supplied code in this contract's storage context.
Mint function restricted to owner or a hardcoded address; overwrites balances and sets the canSale flag.
Owner-only initialiser for _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum; returns nothing (declared bool).
Owner-only loop that multiplies _value by the recipient array length and mutates balances.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation used by ensure.
Payable constructor that sets metadata, totalSupply, owner and an unlimited UNI allowance.
msg.sender: caller address used for access control, allowance checks and balance ownership.
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary calldata in the BabyHippo storage context.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom (arithmetic risk).
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend (overflow risk).
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom (arithmetic risk).
_to recipient parameter of transfer.
_value amount parameter of transfer.
_from source parameter of transferFrom.
_to recipient parameter of transferFrom.
_value amount parameter of transferFrom.
_spender parameter of approve.
a target address parameter of delegate.
b calldata parameter of delegate.
spender parameter of _mints.
addedValue mint amount parameter of _mints.
saleNum parameter of init.
_tos recipient array parameter of batchSend.
_value per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend.
addr parameter of setTradeAddress.
local total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
loop index i in batchSend.
per-iteration _to local in batchSend.

edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as _from.
msg.sender becomes the _from of the transfer, so caller identity controls the fund movement.
msg.sender is compared with _from and used as spender against allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before updating balances.
ensure falls through to condition when no whitelist branch matches.
ensure computes the expected Uniswap pair via pairFor.
ensure compares _from and _to against owner to bypass sale restrictions.
ensure reads canSale[_from] as a whitelist bypass.
ensure compares _from with tradeAddress to bypass sale restrictions.
ensure references the constant UNI router address in its whitelist comparison.
condition reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales.
condition reads _minSale to enforce a lower bound on _value.
condition reads _maxSale to enforce an upper bound on _value.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to count prior sales.
transferFrom directly adds/subtracts balanceOf entries without SafeMath.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] after an unchecked comparison.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every successful transfer.
Unchecked balance subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value executed inside transferFrom.
Unchecked allowance subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value inside transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly.
msg.sender sets an allowance only for itself, but the write is otherwise unrestricted.
delegate performs a low-level delegatecall to arbitrary code that executes in this contract's context.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before reaching the delegatecall.
Only the owner-verified msg.sender can reach the delegatecall unsafe operation.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with the scaled addedValue.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, granting a sale-gating bypass.
_mints scales the mint amount by decimals.
_mints requires msg.sender to be owner or a hardcoded privileged address.
init assigns _minSale from the token argument scaled by decimals.
init assigns _maxSale from the maxToken argument scaled by decimals.
init assigns _saleNum from saleNum.
init requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale configuration.
batchSend subtracts total from and adds _value to balanceOf entries with raw arithmetic.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner and reads balanceOf[msg.sender].
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress state variable.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, seeding the privilege used by all onlyOwner gates.
The constructor sets totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals.
The constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the total supply.
The constructor grants an infinite allowance to the UNI router.
The constructor derives owner and initial balance from the deployer msg.sender.
The unchecked subtraction writes the resulting balance back into balanceOf.
The unchecked multiplication total flows directly into balanceOf updates.
The unchecked allowance subtraction writes back into the allowance mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only an argument of transfer and has no independent semantics.
_value is only an argument of transfer and has no independent semantics.
_from is consumed by transferFrom for allowance, balance and ensure checks.
_to is consumed by transferFrom when crediting the recipient balance.
_value drives the allowance and balance arithmetic inside transferFrom.
_spender is only the key of the allowance write inside approve.
a is only the delegatecall target inside delegate.
b is only the delegatecall payload inside delegate.
spender is only the mint recipient key inside _mints.
addedValue is only the scaled mint amount inside _mints.
saleNum is only assigned to _saleNum inside init.
_tos is only iterated over inside batchSend.
_value is the per-recipient amount used by batchSend.
addr is only written into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
total is the direct product of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
i is the loop counter of batchSend with no independent semantics.
_to is a per-iteration alias of an element of _tos inside batchSend.
